title: Pidge Clothing
subtitle: Rock the Pidge!
intro: Wanted to try a new thing
body:
## The brief

I love clothes. I love fashion brands. I love streetwear. I wanted to understand the industry a bit more. From a commerce point of view. The design process was the easy part. I wanted to understand logistics from creating a supply chain, developing prototypes and making an online store.

Pidge was born from my love of London. Inspired by the critters who inhabit it. Think pigeons, rats and foxes.
